meta.title: 这些❌错误姿势是不是你平时最爱摆的？！
meta.title_en: These 'Wrong' Poses Are Probably Your Favorites!

scenes.title_cn: 错误一：你知道你拍照为什么不好看吗？…
scenes.title_en: Mistake one: know why your photos aren't g…
sentences: 不管摆什么姿势，你非得正面看镜头。
Whatever the pose, you insist on facing the lens.
always front-facing（总正面）
试试侧脸、歪头再看镜头，有没有感觉生动了一点点？
Try a profile, tilt the head, look at the lens—more alive?
add life（生动）
scenes.speak: Whatever the pose, you insist on facing the lens. Try a profile, tilt the head, look at the lens—more alive?

scenes.title_cn: 错误二：一拍照就像发胀，能不讲一码。…
scenes.title_en: Mistake two: you get all puffed and rigid …
sentences: 一拍照就像发胀，不如把胯松一松。
You stiffen at the shutter—loosen the hips instead.
loosen the hips（松胯）
对角的肩膀挑一挑，身体一旦有了层次，包会好看很多。
Lift the opposite shoulder—layers make it look better.
body layers（身体层次）
scenes.speak: You stiffen at the shutter—loosen the hips instead. Lift the opposite shoulder—layers make it look better.

scenes.title_cn: 错误三：上身胖的，咱就是说这照片非得…
scenes.title_en: Mistake three: with a fuller upper body, m…
scenes.context: 上身胖回正面，比例差腿前伸身后拉。
sentences: 上身胖的，这照片非得拍侧面吗？
With a fuller upper body, must it be a side view?
not always side（不必侧面）
把腿往前伸，身体往后拉，近大加远小。
Extend the legs forward, pull the body back—near bigger, far smaller.
perspective trick（近大远小）
scenes.speak: With a fuller upper body, must it be a side view? Extend the legs forward, pull the body back—near bigger, far smaller.

scenes.title_cn: 错误四：还有，你明明想拍的是生命力，…
scenes.title_en: Mistake four: and when you want to capture…
sentences: 你明明想拍的是生命力，却老是做的贼僵硬。
You want vitality but keep going stiff.
stiff vs vital（僵硬与生命力）
弯腰，再弯腰，然后把腿踢起来，生命力的诀窍就在这。
Bend, bend again, kick the leg up—that's the secret.
kick the leg（踢腿）
你以为这就完了？还早着呢。
Think that's all? Far from it.
far from it（还早呢）
paraphrase: stiff vs vital（僵硬与生命力
stiff vs vital（僵硬与生命力
scenes.speak: You want vitality but keep going stiff. Bend, bend again, kick the leg up—that's the secret. Think that's all? Far from it.

practice: Try a profile or head tilt instead of front-facing.
Loosen the hips and lift the opposite shoulder.
Arms back, chest forward, face the front.
Legs forward, body back for better proportions.
Bend down and kick the leg up.
pitfalls: Face the lens straight on every time.
Try a profile or tilted head now and then.
Go puffed and rigid at the shutter.
Loosen the hips and lift the opposite shoulder.
Arms back, chest forward, face front.
Extend legs forward, pull the body back.
比例不好别摆舒展姿势。
Stay stiff when aiming for vitality.
Bend and kick the leg up.
shifts: 说错误姿势只会说 wrong pose
用 profile（侧脸）、loosen the hips（松胯）、opposite shoulder（对侧肩）
用 near bigger far smaller（近大远小）、legs forward（腿前伸）、body back（身后拉）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：拍照为什么不好看、看镜头、正面看镜头、侧脸、歪头、生动了一点点、发胀、胯松一松、对角的肩膀挑一挑、身体有层次、好看很多、上身胖、非得拍侧面吗、胳膊向后方、胸腔转过来、人正一点、不见嫌瘦、动作舒缠、比例不好、拍全身、腿往前伸、身体往后拉、近大加远小、上镜好比例、想拍生命力、贼僵硬、弯腰、再弯腰、腿踢起来、生命力的诀窍、还早着呢等。
